verdict.rationale: Lambda is GPU cloud infrastructure (on-demand instances, clusters, Kubernetes, Slurm). It is not an agent or AI host application that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error. The only MCP-related evidence is an unofficial community-built MCP server that exposes Lambda to other agents. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about, and it is not first-party.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
